scope: Independent read-only source/API review before one authorized case; no model call or remote operation by reviewer

checks.finding: Full request, including top_p/top_k/min_p, equals the frozen primary-reference conditions; engine/model/template and source input hashes are checked.
Preparation and per-stage manifest checks require the immutable renderer policy plus both local source snapshots.
Saved official routes return _debug_info.rendered_template before completion in the debug-only path; request captures stream=false, _debug_render_only=true, truncate=false and shift=false.
Content, thinking, tool calls, nonzero eval_count or prompt_eval_count in render evidence are rejected before generation; anomaly evidence is counted separately.
Only stage1 duplicate-field projection is applied and reverse-checked; subsequent assistant/calculator message strings and transmitted prefixes remain exact.
Fixed system content is literal. Other JSON strings permit only outer space/tab/CR/LF; values and all internal characters remain unchanged and hashes/removed boundaries are recorded.
Renderer output is inspected in order. No exact token count or byte heuristic is claimed. No wrapper message truncation or context shifting is requested.
Each stage has one supervised owned child with a 900-second bound covering metadata, render and generation. Cleanup is explicitly outside the bound; no retry or replacement case exists.
Backend HTTP/error failures stop; output_limit_reached is rejected by workflow.run_case before continuation; strict JSON parse errors stop without repair.
StageStopped carries cancelled or hard_deadline status to the final summary rather than recoding operator cancellation as a model failure.

The selected packet is extracted from the exact previous model request. This run path reads model packet and market data, not evaluator gold; calculate_portfolio uses common market and already-visible evidence IDs.
One fixed Fidelity Q2/R1 case, four sequential stages, no automatic retries, no main calls, main_freeze=false and human_semantic_pass=false are explicit.

resolved_findings.finding: Unexpected render thinking/tool_calls could pass validation
resolved_findings.resolution: Author added fail-closed checks and fake-server cases before source freeze

resolved_findings.finding: Supervisor CANCEL was surfaced as failed
resolved_findings.resolution: Author added StageStopped status propagation before source freeze

limitations: Static/API-path review is not proof of installed-backend context capacity or token preservation after tokenization. Rendered text preservation and explicit flags will be checked against actual saved evidence.
Temperature zero is the requested greedy control; this review does not independently audit every bundled backend sampler implementation. Cross-engine decoding identity with FinVector is not claimed.
Completion means the four-stage workflow executed; it is not strategy quality, human semantic approval, a main-study effect, or a representative institutional sample.
postrun_round2: Pending actual raw outputs; independently recompute exact sums, active weights, variance and source-label/evidence-ID checks without new heuristic cutoffs.
